source.title: National curriculum in England — English Appendix 1: Spelling

scope: Reference inventory of England primary spelling appendix, not validated narrated curriculum.
notes: Years 1–2 exception and example sets are not statutory enumerated 100-word lists; examples are expressly non-statutory.
The Year 1–2 example sets in this seed are representative curated examples from the appendix, not yet a complete transcription of every example in every table.
Years 3–4 and 5–6 lists reproduce all 100 official entry slots each, with optional variant expansion.
Word membership is source-grounded; teaching-pattern classification is heuristic and needs linguistic specialist review.
This catalogue is an inventory, not approved narrated lessons. No unreviewed phoneme audio or child-facing correction scripts are automatically released.
